$comment: Publishing gate for tools/build.mjs. A trip's HTML is generated into site/<outputDir>/index.html ONLY when enabled=true. Each trip below was migrated via tools/extract-trip.mjs with a verified round-trip (docs/ADMIN-DASHBOARD-PLAN.md Phase 1). outputDir defaults to the slug when null. `langs` lists which language variants to render: the French page always writes to site/<outputDir>/, additional languages write to site/<lang>/<outputDir>/ with reciprocal hreflang. A trip with only ["fr"] renders byte-for-byte as before (never passed through the localizer). Only enable a non-fr language once that trip's i18n block is complete — see docs/reference/I18N-SEO.md.
